date.as_written: śakeṃkāṃka bhūpair mite bhādraśukle catur vaktratithye guraubhe pataṃge

notes: The catalogue names Lakṣmīpati as the scribe, but the quoted colophon does not name him; it only states that the commentary (Anvayadīpikā, which is traditionally authored by Lakṣmīpati) was copied by a Brahmin ('dvijena') in Caṅālīpura. Chronogram: aṅka (9) - aṅka (9) - bhūpa (16) = ŚS 1699.
